about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Meen Pollichathu Kerala Pan-Roasted Fish
recipes.summary: Kerala fish smothered in a shallot, tomato and curry leaf masala and roasted in baking paper parcels.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy, then keep it covered.
Heat the coconut oil in a pan over medium heat and fry the shallots, ginger, garlic and curry leaf for 6 minutes until golden and soft.
Add the turmeric, chilli, coriander and tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes until the masala is thick and the oil separates, then stir in the tamarind.
Spread half the masala over four sheets of baking paper, lay a fish fillet on each, top with the remaining masala and fold into sealed parcels.
Bake the parcels at 200°C for 14 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily, then open and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and the thickest part reaches 63°C.
Kerala. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Chicken Chettinad Black Pepper Curry
recipes.summary: Tamil Nadu chicken curry with freshly ground pepper, fennel and coconut for a deep, dry-spiced heat.

items: 800g chicken thigh fillets, cut in chunks

steps: Toast the peppercorns, fennel and desiccated coconut in a dry pan for 2 minutes until fragrant, then grind them to a coarse paste with a splash of water.
Heat the oil in a deep pan and cook the onion and curry leaf for 10 minutes until deeply golden.
Add the ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander and turmeric and stir for 1 minute until fragrant, then add the tomatoes and cook for 6 minutes until jammy.
Stir in the chicken and the pepper paste and cook for 20 minutes with a splash of water until the chicken is tender and the sauce clings.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve the curry over it.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink.
Tamil Nadu. Dinner.

recipes.title: Kerala Nadan Egg Roast with Rice
recipes.summary: Boiled eggs coated in a sweet-onion, tomato and black pepper masala, a classic Kerala home dinner.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until the yolks are set, then cool them in cold water and peel.
Heat the coconut oil in a wide pan and cook the onion and curry leaf for 12 minutes until soft and golden brown.
Stir in the ginger, garlic, turmeric, chilli and coriander for 1 minute, then add the tomatoes and cook for 8 minutes until thick and oily.
Add a splash of water and the garam masala, then slide in the eggs and roll them for 3 minutes until coated and hot.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy and serve with the eggs.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are firm and keep leftovers refrigerated for up to 2 days.
Kerala. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Jjimdak Andong Braised Chicken with Sweet Potato Noodles
recipes.summary: Andong-style soy-braised chicken with potato, carrot and chewy glass noodles in a sweet, savoury glaze.
steps: Soak the noodles in warm water for 30 minutes, and blanch the chicken in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain.
Combine the soy sauce, sugar, ginger, garlic and 2 cups of water in a large pot and bring to a simmer until the sugar dissolves.
Add the chicken, potato, carrot and onion and simmer covered for 25 minutes until the chicken is cooked and the vegetables are tender.
Drain the noodles, stir them in with the sesame oil and chillies and simmer 5 minutes until the noodles are soft and the sauce is glossy.
Top with the spring onion and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the thickest part reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Andong, Korea. Dinner.

recipes.title: Galbi Jjim Korean Braised Short Ribs
recipes.summary: Slow-braised beef short ribs with daikon, carrot and jujube in a sweet soy and pear glaze.

items: 1.2 kg beef short ribs, cut in pieces

steps: Soak the ribs in cold water for 1 hour, then blanch them in boiling water for 8 minutes and rinse off the scum.
Mix the pear, soy sauce, sugar, ginger, garlic and half the sesame oil with 2 cups of water in a heavy pot.
Add the ribs and onion and simmer covered on low for 1 hour 30 minutes until the meat is nearly tender.
Add the daikon and carrot and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the sauce thickens to a glaze.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy, then serve the ribs over it with the spring onion and remaining sesame oil.
notes: Food safety: braise the beef until it reaches at least 75°C and falls tender from the bone.
Korea. Dinner. Festive dish.

recipes.title: Buta no Kakuni Japanese Braised Pork Belly
recipes.summary: Pork belly simmered until meltingly tender in soy, mirin and ginger, served with soft eggs and rice.
steps: Simmer the whole belly in plenty of water for 1 hour 15 minutes until a skewer slides in easily, then cool and cut in 4 cm cubes.
Combine the soy sauce, mirin, sake, sugar, ginger and spring onion with 1 cup of water in a pot and add the pork.
Simmer covered on low for 45 minutes until the pork is very tender, then boil the eggs for 7 minutes until just set, peel and add them for the last 10 minutes.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy, and steam the bok choy for 3 minutes until tender.
Reduce the braising liquid for 5 minutes until syrupy, then serve the pork and halved eggs over the rice with the glaze.
notes: Food safety: simmer the pork until it reaches 75°C throughout and keep leftovers refrigerated.
Japan. Dinner.

recipes.title: Sake Shioyaki Salt-Grilled Salmon Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Crisp salt-grilled salmon with grated daikon, lemon and rice, a Japanese home dinner in 25 minutes.
steps: Salt the salmon on both sides and leave for 10 minutes, then pat dry.
Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Toss the cucumber with the vinegar and sesame seeds for a quick pickle.
Grill the salmon skin side up under a hot grill for 8 minutes until the skin blisters and the flesh flakes.
Serve the fish with the rice, a mound of grated daikon, the cucumber and lemon wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until it flakes and reaches 63°C; use only very fresh fish.
Japan. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Tebasaki Nagoya Sticky Pepper Chicken Wings
recipes.summary: Twice-cooked Nagoya wings with a sweet soy glaze and plenty of black pepper and sesame, served with rice.
steps: Toss the wings with the cornflour and a pinch of salt, brush with the oil and spread on a lined tray.
Bake at 220°C for 35 minutes, turning once, until the skin is crisp and the wings are cooked through.
Simmer the soy sauce, mirin, sugar and garlic for 4 minutes until syrupy.
Toss the hot wings in the glaze with the pepper and sesame seeds until coated.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve the wings with it.
notes: Food safety: cook the wings until the thickest part reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Nagoya, Japan. Dinner.

recipes.title: Hambagu Japanese Hamburg Steak with Demi Sauce
recipes.summary: Juicy Japanese-style hamburg steaks in a ketchup, Worcestershire and mushroom sauce, served with rice.
steps: Soften the onion in half the oil for 5 minutes until translucent, then cool.
Mix the beef, onion, panko, egg, milk, nutmeg and a pinch of salt, knead until sticky and shape into four oval patties.
Fry the patties in the remaining oil for 4 minutes per side until browned and cooked through at 75°C, then lift out.
Fry the mushrooms in the same pan for 4 minutes until golden, add the ketchup, Worcestershire, soy sauce and 1/2 cup of water and simmer until thick.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve the patties with the sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook the mince patties until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink remaining.
Japan. Dinner.

recipes.title: Moo Ping Bangkok Coconut Pork Street Plates
recipes.summary: Coconut and coriander-root marinated pork skewers grilled until caramelised and served with sticky rice.
steps: Crush the garlic and coriander root, then mix with the oyster sauce, fish sauce, sugar, coconut milk and pepper and coat the pork. Marinate 2 hours.
Soak the rice for 2 hours, then steam it over simmering water for 25 minutes until tender and sticky.
Thread the pork onto skewers.
Grill over medium-high heat for 12 minutes, turning, until browned at the edges and cooked through.
Serve the skewers with the sticky rice, cucumber and chilli.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink remaining.
Thailand. Dinner.

recipes.title: Pad Kra Pao Gai Thai Basil Chicken with Fried Egg
recipes.summary: Hot and savoury minced chicken stir-fried with chilli, garlic and basil, topped with a crisp fried egg.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat and fry the garlic and chilli for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the chicken and beans and stir-fry for 5 minutes until cooked through and lightly browned.
Add the oyster sauce, soy, fish sauce and sugar and toss for 1 minute until glossy, then fold through the basil until just wilted.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are crisp and the yolks are cooked to your liking, then serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken mince to 75°C and fry the eggs until the whites are fully set.
Thailand. Dinner.

recipes.title: Phuket Dry-Fried Beef Mince Curry with Turmeric
recipes.summary: Fiery southern Thai dry-fried beef with turmeric, lemongrass and kaffir lime, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium-high heat and fry the curry paste, turmeric, lemongrass and ginger for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the beef and stir-fry for 8 minutes, breaking it up, until cooked through and the pan is nearly dry.
Season with the fish sauce and sugar and toss through the lime leaves and chilli for 1 minute until the leaves are bright.
Serve with the rice and cucumber.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef mince until it reaches 75°C with no pink remaining.
Southern Thailand. Dinner.

recipes.title: Thai Lime Steamed Fish Plates with Lemongrass
recipes.summary: Tender steamed fish in a hot, sour lime, garlic and chilli broth, served over jasmine rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Lay the lemongrass and lime leaves on a heatproof plate, top with the fish and steam over simmering water for 10 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes.
Stir the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, garlic and chilli together until the sugar dissolves.
Pour the sauce over the hot fish, scatter with the coriander and steam for 1 minute more until the aromatics are fragrant.
Serve the fish and its juices over the rice.
notes: Food safety: steam the fish until it reaches 63°C and flakes easily.
Thailand. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Ca Kho To Vietnamese Caramel-Braised Fish
recipes.summary: Firm white fish braised in a dark caramel, fish sauce and pepper sauce, a southern Vietnamese staple.

items: 4 firm white fish fillets, cut in thick pieces

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Melt the sugar in a heavy pot with 2 tbsp of water over medium heat for 5 minutes until it turns deep amber.
Add the shallot, garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then pour in the fish sauce, 1/2 cup of water and the pepper.
Lay in the fish and simmer for 10 minutes, spooning the sauce over, until the fish is cooked and the sauce is thick and glossy.
Scatter with the chilli and spring onion and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until it reaches 63°C and flakes easily.
Vietnam. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Thit Kho Trung Vietnamese Braised Pork and Eggs
recipes.summary: Pork belly and eggs braised in caramel and fish sauce, the Tet table favourite, with rice.
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes until just set, then cool and peel.
Caramelise the sugar in a heavy pot over medium heat for 4 minutes until amber, then add the pork, shallots and garlic and stir for 5 minutes until coated and lightly browned.
Add the fish sauce, pepper and water and simmer covered for 45 minutes until the pork is tender.
Add the eggs and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes until the sauce is thick and the eggs are glazed.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve with the spring onion.
notes: Food safety: braise the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender; boil the eggs until the yolk is firm.
Vietnam. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Lamb Kaldereta Filipino Tomato and Peanut Stew
recipes.summary: Filipino festive stew of lamb with tomato, capsicum, olives and peanut butter, simmered until rich.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in batches for 8 minutes until deep golden, then set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic in the same pot for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, bay leaves, chilli, lamb and 1 cup of water and simmer covered for 1 hour 15 minutes until the lamb is nearly tender.
Add the potato and carrot and cook 25 minutes until tender, then stir in the capsicum, olives and peanut butter and simmer 5 minutes until thick.
Taste, season and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until it reaches at least 75°C and is tender.
Philippines. Dinner. Contains peanuts. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Bicol Express Pork in Chilli Coconut Cream
recipes.summary: Pork simmered in coconut cream with long green chillies and shrimp paste, the fiery dish of the Bicol region.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender and fluffy.
Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook the onion, garlic and ginger for 5 minutes until soft, then stir in the shrimp paste for 1 minute.
Add the pork and brown for 6 minutes, then pour in the coconut cream and fish sauce.
Simmer gently for 30 minutes until the pork is tender and the cream reduces and turns oily.
Stir in the chillies and cook 3 minutes until tender, then serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until it reaches 75°C throughout and is tender.
Bicol, Philippines. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Beef Salpicao Filipino Garlic Beef with Rice
recipes.summary: Seared beef cubes with lots of garlic, mushrooms, soy and Worcestershire, served over garlic rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Toss the beef with the soy sauce, Worcestershire and pepper.
Sear the beef in the oil over high heat in two batches for 3 minutes until browned and just cooked through, then set aside.
Melt the butter and fry the garlic for 2 minutes until golden, add the mushrooms and cook 4 minutes until tender, then return the beef with its juices.
Toss for 1 minute until glossy and serve over the rice with the spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef cubes until browned all over and the centre reaches at least 63°C.
Philippines. Dinner.

recipes.title: Lechon Kawali Crispy Pork Belly with Vinegar Dip
recipes.summary: Pork belly simmered with bay and peppercorns, dried and deep-fried until blistered, with a sharp vinegar dip.
steps: Simmer the pork with the bay, peppercorns, salt and onion in water for 1 hour 15 minutes until tender, then lift out, pat very dry and chill uncovered for 2 hours.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Mix the vinegar, red onion, garlic, chilli and a pinch of salt for the dip.
Heat the oil to 180°C in a deep heavy pot and carefully fry the pork skin side down for 10 minutes, covered with a splatter guard, until the skin blisters and turns golden.
Rest 5 minutes, chop into pieces and serve with the rice and dip.
notes: Food safety: simmer the pork until it reaches 75°C; keep water away from hot oil and never leave it unattended.
Philippines. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pininyahang Manok Filipino Chicken in Pineapple and Milk
recipes.summary: Chicken braised with pineapple, carrot, capsicum and evaporated milk into a gently sweet, creamy stew.

items: 800g chicken thigh fillets, cut in chunks

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Brown the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the onion and garlic and cook 3 minutes until soft.
Add the fish sauce, water, pineapple and carrot and simmer covered for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the carrot is tender.
Stir in the capsicum and evaporated milk and simmer gently 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Taste the sauce, adjust with a little fish sauce if needed, then spoon the chicken and creamy sauce over the rice and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink.
Philippines. Dinner.

recipes.title: Adobong Pusit Filipino Squid Adobo
recipes.summary: Tender squid simmered quickly in vinegar, soy, garlic and pepper, served with rice to catch the sauce.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Fry the garlic and onion in the oil for 4 minutes until soft and golden.
Add the vinegar, soy sauce, bay, peppercorns and sugar and simmer 3 minutes without stirring until the sharp smell mellows.
Add the squid and cook for 6 minutes until just tender and curled, then reduce the sauce for 3 minutes until it clings.
Serve the squid and sauce over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the squid until opaque and firm and use only fresh, well-chilled squid.
Philippines. Dinner.

recipes.title: Semur Daging Javanese Sweet Soy Beef Stew
recipes.summary: Beef and potato braised in sweet soy with nutmeg, clove and cinnamon, a gentle Javanese-Dutch home dish.
steps: Brown the beef in the oil in batches for 6 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic in the same pot for 5 minutes until soft, then add the nutmeg, cloves and cinnamon for 30 seconds.
Return the beef with the kecap manis, soy sauce, tomatoes and water and simmer covered for 1 hour until the beef is nearly tender.
Add the potato and cook 25 minutes until tender and the sauce is thick and glossy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve the stew over it.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until tender and at least 75°C throughout.
Java, Indonesia. Dinner.

recipes.title: Gulai Kambing Sumatran Lamb Curry
recipes.summary: Lamb simmered in a turmeric, lemongrass and coconut milk gravy, rich and aromatic, from Sumatra.
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, ginger, turmeric, coriander and cumin to a paste with a splash of water.
Fry the paste in the oil for 6 minutes until fragrant and the oil separates, then add the lamb and brown for 6 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, 1 cup of water, lemongrass, lime leaves and chilli and simmer covered for 1 hour 15 minutes until the lamb is tender.
Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes until the gravy thickens slightly.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve the curry over it.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until at least 75°C throughout and tender.
Sumatra, Indonesia. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Ayam Betutu Balinese Spiced Roast Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken rubbed with the Balinese base genep spice paste and slow roasted in a sealed foil parcel until falling tender.
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, chilli, ginger, galangal, turmeric, lemongrass, pepper, shrimp paste and oil to a thick paste.
Rub the paste all over the chicken and marinate in the fridge for 2 hours.
Wrap the chicken and all the paste in a sealed double layer of foil on a tray and roast at 160°C for 1 hour 30 minutes until the meat is very tender.
Open the parcel and roast at 220°C for 15 minutes until the skin is browned and sticky.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve the chicken with its juices.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the thickest part reaches 75°C and the juices run clear.
Bali, Indonesia. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pepes Ikan Sundanese Spiced Fish Parcels
recipes.summary: Fish in a turmeric, lemongrass and chilli paste steamed in baking paper parcels, the Sundanese way.
steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, chilli, turmeric, ginger, half the lemongrass, oil and salt to a coarse paste.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Coat each fillet in the paste and place on a sheet of baking paper with the tomato, basil, remaining lemongrass and lime juice, then fold into sealed parcels.
Bake at 200°C for 18 minutes until the fish is opaque and flakes easily.
Open the parcels and serve over the rice with the juices.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until opaque and the thickest part reaches 63°C.
West Java, Indonesia. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Ayam Rica-Rica Manado Chilli Chicken
recipes.summary: North Sulawesi chicken fried with a big chilli, lemongrass and basil paste until sticky and fiery.

items: 800g chicken thigh fillets, cut in chunks

steps: Blend the chillies, shallots, garlic, ginger, lemongrass and tomatoes to a coarse paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 10 minutes until the raw smell goes and the oil separates.
Add the chicken and 1/2 cup of water and simmer covered for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce is thick.
Stir in the sugar, lime juice and basil until the basil wilts.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve with the chicken.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink.
Manado, Indonesia. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Asam Pedas Melaka Sour and Spicy Fish Stew
recipes.summary: White fish and okra simmered in a tamarind, chilli and lemongrass gravy, a Melaka classic.

items: 4 white fish fillets, in thick pieces

steps: Blend the shallots, garlic, dried chillies, ginger and turmeric to a smooth paste.
Fry the paste in the oil for 8 minutes until darker and fragrant, then add the lemongrass, tamarind, water and sugar and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the tomato and okra and simmer for 5 minutes until the okra is tender.
Slide in the fish and cook gently for 8 minutes until opaque and cooked through.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve the stew over it.
notes: Food safety: cook the fish until it reaches 63°C and flakes easily.
Melaka, Malaysia. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Ayam Masak Merah Malaysian Tomato Chilli Chicken
recipes.summary: Fried chicken simmered in a sweet-hot tomato and chilli sauce, the Malay festive favourite.

items: 800g chicken thigh fillets, cut in chunks

steps: Blend the dried chillies, shallots, garlic and ginger to a paste.
Brown the chicken with the turmeric in half the oil for 8 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Fry the chilli paste in the remaining oil for 8 minutes until fragrant, add the tomato paste and tinned tomatoes and cook 6 minutes until thick.
Return the chicken with the onion, sugar, tamarind and 1/2 cup of water and simmer 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and glossy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve with the chicken.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink.
Malaysia. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mombasa Grilled Chicken in Coconut and Tamarind Gravy
recipes.summary: Mombasa-style grilled chicken simmered in a creamy coconut, tamarind and turmeric gravy.
steps: Rub the chicken with half the turmeric, a pinch of salt and half the garlic, then grill for 12 minutes until charred at the edges.
Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes until golden, add the ginger, remaining garlic, spices and chilli and cook 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes until soft, then pour in the coconut milk and tamarind.
Add the chicken and simmer for 15 minutes until cooked through and the sauce is creamy.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve with the curry and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink.
Kenya. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Doro Wat Ethiopian Chicken and Egg Stew
recipes.summary: Ethiopia's celebration stew of slowly cooked onions, berbere and spiced butter with tender chicken and boiled eggs.
steps: Cook the onions in a dry heavy pot over medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring often, until they reduce and turn sweet and golden.
Add the butter, ginger, garlic, berbere and tomato paste and cook for 15 minutes on low until a deep red paste forms.
Add the wine, stock and chicken and simmer covered for 40 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes until set, peel, prick lightly and simmer in the stew for the last 10 minutes.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve with the stew.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the thickest part reaches 75°C and the eggs until the yolks are firm.
Ethiopia. Dinner.

recipes.title: Zigni Eritrean Berbere Beef Stew
recipes.summary: Eritrean beef stew with onions, tomato and berbere cooked down until thick, dark and deeply spiced.
steps: Cook the onions in a dry heavy pot for 15 minutes, stirring often, until reduced and golden.
Add the butter, berbere, tomato paste, ginger and garlic and cook for 10 minutes on low until thick and dark.
Add the beef, stock and cardamom and simmer covered for 1 hour until the beef is nearly tender.
Add the potato and simmer for 25 minutes until tender and the sauce is thick.
Taste, season and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until at least 75°C throughout and tender.
Eritrea. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Seared Kitfo-Style Beef with Chilli and Spiced Butter
recipes.summary: Fully cooked Ethiopian-style minced beef with spiced butter, mitmita and cardamom, served with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Melt the butter with the turmeric, cardamom, garlic and ginger over medium heat for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the onion and cook 4 minutes until soft, then stir in the beef and chilli and cook for 8 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Stir in the lemon juice and season.
Serve the beef with the rice and a spoonful of cottage cheese.
notes: Food safety: this version is fully cooked, so cook the mince until it reaches 75°C with no pink remaining.
Ethiopia. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Luwombo Ugandan Chicken and Groundnut Parcels
recipes.summary: Chicken and mushrooms in a peanut sauce steamed in baking paper parcels, served with sweet potato.

items: 800g chicken thigh fillets, cut in chunks

steps: Fry the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, then add the tomatoes and turmeric and cook 5 minutes until thick.
Whisk in the peanut butter and stock until smooth, then mix with the chicken and mushrooms.
Divide among four double sheets of baking paper, fold and tie into sealed parcels and set in a deep ovenproof dish with 2 cm of water.
Bake covered with foil at 170°C for 1 hour 15 minutes until the chicken is tender, adding the sweet potato in a separate tray for the last 40 minutes to roast until soft.
Open the parcels and serve with the sweet potato.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink.
Uganda. Dinner. Contains peanuts. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Frikkadelle South African Meatballs with Yellow Rice
recipes.summary: Spiced beef meatballs baked until golden and served with sweet turmeric and raisin yellow rice.
steps: Soak the bread in the milk, then mix the beef, onion, squeezed bread, egg, coriander, nutmeg and a pinch of salt and shape into 16 balls.
Bake the meatballs on an oiled tray at 200°C for 20 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Simmer the rice with the turmeric, raisins, cinnamon stick and 3 cups of water covered for 15 minutes until tender and fluffy.
Brush the meatballs with the chutney and bake 5 minutes until glossy.
Serve the meatballs over the yellow rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the meatballs until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink remaining.
South Africa. Dinner.

recipes.title: Huli Huli Hawaiian Pineapple-Glazed Chicken
recipes.summary: Hawaiian grilled chicken turned in a pineapple, soy and ginger glaze until sticky and caramelised.
steps: Whisk the pineapple juice, soy sauce, ketchup, sugar, ginger and garlic together and marinate the chicken for 2 hours, reserving a third of the mixture.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Simmer the reserved marinade for 6 minutes until syrupy.
Grill the chicken and pineapple for 18 minutes, turning and brushing with the glaze, until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Serve with the rice and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until the thickest part reaches 75°C; boil any marinade that touched raw chicken before using it as a glaze.
Hawaii. Dinner.

recipes.title: Lu Pulu Tongan Beef in Coconut Cream
recipes.summary: Tongan beef and onion baked in coconut cream in a sealed parcel until soft and rich, served with kumara.
steps: Mix the beef with the onion, garlic, lemon juice and salt and place on a large double layer of baking paper over foil.
Pour over the coconut cream, fold and seal the parcel tightly and set it in a baking dish.
Bake at 160°C for 1 hour 45 minutes until the beef is very tender.
Add the sweet potato to a tray and roast at 200°C for 35 minutes until golden and soft, and wilt the silverbeet in the beef juices for 3 minutes until tender.
Serve the beef with the sweet potato and juices.
notes: Food safety: cook the beef until at least 75°C throughout and tender.
Tonga. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Hong Shao Rou Shanghai Red-Braised Pork Belly
recipes.summary: Pork belly braised in caramel, soy and Shaoxing wine until glossy and soft, served with rice and greens.
steps: Blanch the pork in boiling water for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Melt the sugar in a heavy pot with a splash of water over medium heat for 4 minutes until amber, add the pork and toss for 5 minutes until coated and lightly browned.
Add the wine, soy sauce, ginger, star anise, cinnamon, spring onion and water and simmer covered on low for 1 hour until the pork is tender.
Boil uncovered for 10 minutes until the sauce reduces to a sticky glaze.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy, steam the bok choy for 3 minutes until tender and serve everything together.
notes: Food safety: braise the pork until it reaches 75°C and is tender.
Shanghai, China. Dinner.

recipes.title: Lion's Head Meatballs Yangzhou Pork and Cabbage
recipes.summary: Large soft pork and ginger meatballs braised on a bed of wombok until tender, a Jiangsu classic.
steps: Mix the pork, egg, ginger, spring onion, half the wine, half the soy sauce and the cornflour, stirring one way until sticky, and shape into four large balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, then set aside.
Layer the wombok in a pot, set the meatballs on top and add the stock, remaining wine and soy.
Cover and simmer gently for 35 minutes until the meatballs reach 75°C and the cabbage is silky.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and serve the meatballs with the cabbage and broth.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork meatballs until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink.
Yangzhou, China. Dinner.

recipes.title: Salt and Pepper Squid Cantonese-Style with Rice
recipes.summary: Crisp cornflour-coated squid tossed with chilli, garlic and Sichuan pepper salt, served with rice and greens.

items: 600g squid tubes, scored and cut in pieces

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Pat the squid very dry and toss in the cornflour mixed with the white pepper.
Heat the oil to 190°C in a wok and fry the squid in two batches for 90 seconds until crisp and pale golden, then drain.
Pour off most oil, stir-fry the chilli, garlic, spring onion, Sichuan pepper and salt for 1 minute until fragrant, then toss through the squid.
Blanch the gai lan for 2 minutes until tender and serve with the squid and rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the squid until opaque and firm and take care with hot oil.
Guangdong, China. Dinner. Naturally gluten-free.

recipes.title: Yu Xiang Qiezi Sichuan Fish-Fragrant Eggplant
recipes.summary: Silky fried eggplant in a garlicky, sour-sweet Sichuan chilli bean sauce, with no fish in sight.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Fry the eggplant in half the oil in batches for 8 minutes until golden and soft, then set aside.
Stir-fry the chilli bean paste, ginger and garlic in the remaining oil for 1 minute until the oil turns red.
Add the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and 1/2 cup of water, return the eggplant and simmer 4 minutes until tender.
Stir through the cornflour mixed with water until the sauce thickens and glazes, then top with the spring onion and serve with the rice.
notes: Vegan. Sichuan, China. Dinner.

recipes.title: Ojingeo Bokkeum Korean Spicy Stir-Fried Squid
recipes.summary: Squid and cabbage stir-fried in a sweet gochujang and gochugaru sauce, served over rice.

items: 600g squid tubes, scored and cut in pieces

steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Mix the gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, sugar and garlic into a sauce.
Stir-fry the onion, cabbage and carrot in the neutral oil over high heat for 4 minutes until just tender.
Add the squid and sauce and toss for 4 minutes until the squid is opaque and curled and the sauce clings.
Finish with the sesame oil and spring onion and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the squid until opaque and firm; do not overcook or it turns rubbery.
Korea. Dinner.

recipes.title: Char Siu Cantonese Roast Pork with Rice and Greens
recipes.summary: Sticky honey-hoisin roast pork scroll shoulder, sliced over rice with steamed greens.

items: 700g pork scotch fillet, cut in strips

steps: Mix the hoisin, 1 tbsp honey, soy sauce, wine, garlic and five spice, coat the pork and marinate for 4 hours.
Roast the pork on a rack over a tray of water at 200°C for 35 minutes, basting twice, until sticky and browned.
Brush with the remaining honey and grill 3 minutes until charred at the edges.
Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy and blanch the gai lan for 2 minutes until tender.
Rest the pork for 5 minutes, slice and serve with the rice, greens and pan juices.
notes: Food safety: roast the pork until the centre reaches 75°C with no pink.
Guangdong, China. Dinner.
